learning: Iteration 8 showed that y=0.03 m cost about 17 points (41.1 vs 58.5), so the forward lead stays at y=0.05 m. Iterations 5 to 7 bracketed wheel_radius at 0.03 m, and mass 0.8 kg was confirmed by iteration 6. The footprint is the only geometry lever tested in this iteration. If line loss rises at the outer sensors, the footprint or span needs to change, not the controller.
rationale: Iteration 4 is the best design (58.54). Iterations 5 to 8 each moved one geometry or controller variable away from it and scored lower (41.4, 42.7, 57.9, 41.1), so the iteration 4 layout and gains are close to a local optimum. The Builder's single change is sensor_size 0.016 to 0.012 m. Each sensor now sees a smaller patch of tape, so the readings are sharper but the outer sensors cover less of the tape. The signal weights are unchanged, so the controller does not need retuning for the footprint change. I keep the iteration 4 gains (kp 1.35, ki 0.02, kd 0.25, base_speed 1.5, last_direction) so the race isolates the footprint. Expected: score near 58, progress at or above 0.185 on the s-bend, and line loss at or below iteration 4. Risk: the outer sensors at +/-0.06 m reach only about +/-0.066 m with 12 mm footprints, so edge line loss could rise. I make no outcome claim.
